payload.title: 2. Scheduled knowledge run in AWS (L)
payload.description:
Shipped story: ship-09ea2c (scheduled run half). Size L. BLOCKED pending Ryan's approval.

As an operator, I want the weekly knowledge run (BERTopic + GLiNER2) to run on a schedule in AWS, so that it does not depend on the workstation.

Acceptance criteria:
- A scheduled AWS job runs the BERTopic + GLiNER2 topic run weekly and feeds the archive from story 1.
- The run carries the stale-checkout guard and the #565 projection-deletion guard: it refuses to run or publish from a stale checkout, and never deletes projected data on a bad run.
- Secrets/config follow existing SSM and IaC conventions; nothing is created manually.
- A failed run leaves the previous archive and projection intact and is reported.
- All behaviour here ships with Gherkin specs (Feature/Scenario/Given/When/Then) in the repo, written first and green before close.
